content: Un'kàbɔ kan'syäŋà Mwol
Ungö pa, mɛ kàwem u du asànaa ndaa a ngwal yà un'sɛŋ a kölàköl awà u du wàmutɛn naa:

content.text: Ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈, làkoo anà ngwal bye akà Nzam abi!
Ntɔn ntsüül a nsaŋ ande yanswà yà ndandaa anà yà balàbal!
Ntɔn nde kàpɛ ntaaŋàmbar akà un'kaar a pasàsɛ a kölàköl,
ntɔn nde kàbwiyà mɛɛn unsà ipasàsɛ ande.
Nde kun'fuur mfur a an'kil a asyääl ande. »

content: Ba bàfàtɛn naa: « Alɛluya! Un'diŋ awa wàmubeenà du mbul a in'tye! »
Apan andweer an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋinà anà ikyeer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ inà bàbü an'köm, waa bàkömà Nzam awàfàyaal u kir a imwol anà mutɛn naa: « Yà abwɛy! Alɛluya! »
Un'kyɔm a bɔr a un'tö a un'kɔk!
Ndaa yàtoo u kir a imwol, waa yàtɛn naa: « Lun'syäŋà Nzam abi, bɛ asyääl ande banswà, bɛ baar làfàkyey Nzam, ambɛy anà andweer! »
Apan mɛ kàwem asànaa ndaa a un'kàbɔ a baar, asànaa làso a ngyäl a kölàköl anà asànaa idum a mbul a ngwal yàmutɛn naa:

content.text: Wɛy bi isäŋ anà ikäl aŋàyɔl a un'sak,
Ntɔn taaŋ a un'kyɔm a bɔr a un'tö a un'kɔk lan'kwo,
Nde bun'pɛ mbwo mubwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür, kyà in'ŋyäŋ anà kyà tsɛk tsɛk. »

content: Ntɔn ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür ikaswaŋà naa isal a balàbal byà aŋin'kyɛɛl.
Un'kyeey mwɛy kàtɛn amɛ naa: « Sɔn: Un'sak akà baar abà bàbel kà un'kyɔm a bɔr a un'tö a un'kɔk. » Nde kàfàkwɛy aba: « Yayi yanswà yà ndaa a Nzam yà ndandaa. »

Apan, mɛ kàbü an'köm kusà a nde ntɔn mukun'kömà, wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a mɛ naa: « Twon aman'kömà! Mɛ in'wà un'syääl asànaa ngye anà atɔŋ angye abà bàlää unsà imbäl a Yɛsu. Làkoo ngye asà Nzam! » Ntɔn imbäl a Yɛsu kyà dweelà a ngɔɔm.
Un'syeen a mpoonà udu a mpoonà a pɛɛl
Apan, mɛ kàmɛn du làŋàdubà, mpoonà a pɛl kàyàmɛnà. Mbuur kàläär udu awa bàfun'bel « Lää » anà « Ndandaa ». Nde afàtsul nsaŋ anà afànwaan unsà balàbal.
Mii ande myà asànaa làlɛm a mbaa. Nde we anà mpà a imwol mbɔɔn udu a un'tswe anà ikɔb aŋàsɔn akyà uyöb nde mpɛl.
Nde wàŋàbwaar kàzak aŋànwɛmà unsà an'kil. Ikɔb ande « Ndaa a Nzam ».
In'lwaŋ a aŋità a du myàyun'labà udu a mpoonà a pɛɛl, myaŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür kyà pɛɛl anà kyà tsɛk tsɛk.
Kɔm aŋàsye làtoo u mun ande ntɔn mukam in'sɛŋ. Nde asàkal un'kyɛɛŋ aba anà un'aŋ wà ishabà, anà nde asàbwɛɛr rɛzɛ uboo a mpfwee ipölà vin a un'fur a nkyɛl a Nzam Aŋangwal.
Udu a kàzak ande anà udu a ipɛl ande bàsön ikɔb ki: « Mfum a amfum anà Mwol a amwol ».
Apan, mɛ kàmɛn un'kyeey aŋàmbar uboo a taaŋ. Nde kasi in'kwɛŋ u ndaa a ngwal akà nɛn yanswà yàyafumà u dudu: « Làyi, làköŋ ntɔn un'kyɔm a kölàköl wà Nzam!
Abun, yàladi in'twaŋ a amfum, in'twaŋ a amfum a aŋità, in'twaŋ a aŋangwal, in'twaŋ a mpoonà anà myà baar bàfàsyen ya, in'twaŋ a baar banswà, baar a nsaay anà asɔ, ambɛy anà andweer. »
Ungö apan, mɛ kàmɛn ntsür, amfum a mɛɛn anà in'lwaaŋ a ità aba, bàŋàköŋ ntɔn munwaan a mbuur afàlaar udu a mpoonà anà un'lwaaŋ a ità ande.

Ntsür bàkyer un'kɔr anà ŋangɔɔm ande wàloor kàkyer idiim ibaŋ kusà ande ntɔn mubwiy ndwaŋ baar abà bàwɛl inyɛm a ntsür anà bàkömà itɛk awa. Ntsür anà ŋangɔɔm a loor batɔɔm bàmɔ̈ɔ̈ u yaaŋ a mbaa.
Baar bumwɛy bàkyer adwa a kɔm alà làtoo u mun a mbuur kàkäl udu a mpoonà. Nɛn yanswà yàyüür a in'twaŋ aba.
